description: This is a Java test class for the Device Registration component's JMS-based integration tests. It verifies behaviors such as request validation and device registration handling via JUnit 5 and Vert.x.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationJmsIT
classes.description: JUnit 5 integration test class for Device Registration JMS endpoint, extending the base API test class.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before all tests, setting up the helper and JMS connection.

methods.name: getJmsBasedClient
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a JMS-based registration client for a given tenant.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Provides a generic RegistrationClient interface for tests.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Cleans up test artifacts after each test, such as registry objects.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the test environment after all tests, disconnecting JMS connection.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForMissingDeviceId
methods.description: Test case verifying that asserting registration without device ID results in HTTP 400.

methods.name: testRequestFailsForMissingSubject
methods.description: Test verifying that a missing subject in request leads to HTTP 400.

methods.name: testRequestFailsForUnsupportedOperation
methods.description: Test verifying that an unsupported operation in request results in HTTP 400.
